scope: Time-boxed feasibility probe for executing a CuRobo plan on the pinned stack. No package was installed, no environment was modified and no job was submitted. This records why Phase 5 stopped, not a planning result.

pinned_stack.container: Humanoid_Lite/container/bhl.sif (no python3, no nvcc inside the image)

upstream_compatibility.assessment: Compatible in principle with the pinned venv; not verified by a build.

pypi_warning: The PyPI name nvidia-curobo (version 0.1, summary 'A simple python package') is not NVIDIA's CuRobo and must not be installed.
blockers: CuRobo is not part of the pinned stack. Running it means installing it, which the Phase 5 time box forbids doing by modifying the pinned environment.
Installing it compiles CUDA extensions against torch 2.11 + CUDA 13.0. That build is too heavy for the 400-process submit node and belongs in a scheduled job.
venv-isaac60 lives in the separate Humanoid_Lite project and serves it too; modifying it risks jobs outside this repository.
Executing a plan needs a GPU allocation, which requires a separate budget approval.
path_forward: Build CuRobo into a separate target directory on /nfs/hpc/share (never into venv-isaac60), with CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/apps/cuda/13.0 and MAX_JOBS limited, inside a scheduled job.

Import it in a frozen GPU job alongside venv-isaac60 via PYTHONPATH, construct the world from the existing sphere evidence and orchard collision meshes, and plan to the 0.08 m pre-cut standoff used by the scripted ToF servo.
Compare on the recorded tree0 targets: plan success, planning time, path length, minimum clearance and measured contacts.
not_claimed: No CuRobo plan has been executed.
No motion-planning or collision-avoidance capability is claimed.
